items.title: IETF Publishes RFC 10008, Adding the QUERY Method for Safe Requests With a Body
items.summaryShort: IETF Publishes RFC 10008, Adding the QUERY Method for Safe Requests With a Body. In June 2026, the IETF published RFC 10008, introducing the QUERY method to HTTP, the first new standard HTTP verb since 2010.
